title: Motshodi wa Matshwao a le Robongwe
intro: Setshwantsho se ne sa tsoga go tswa mo tshimologong e e ikokobeditseng thata, ka phelelo e e kwadilweng ka thato ya bomodimo. E ne e fitlhegile kgakala mo boseeng mme e godisitswe mo teng ga dipota tsa mmusi yo o neng a batla go senya batho ba bone, moya ono o ne wa feleletsa o biditswe go ya go dira tiro e e nonofileng. E re ka ba ne ba sa tlhomelelwa ke sepe fa e se tumelo le thobane ya modisa e e ikokobeditseng, ba ne ba ema fa pele ga mmusi yo o maatla go gaisa botlhe wa motlha oo mme ba batla gore batho ba ba neng ba dirilwe makgoba ba gololwe. Lefatshe ka bolone le ne le lebega le tsamaya ka taelo ya bone — metsi a kgaogana, magodimo a bua, mme bogosi jwa wa.
clues: Malatsi a me a ntlha a ne a tshwailwe ke poifo — masea a a tshwanang le nna a ne a tsongwa fa a tsholwa ke mmusi yo o senang kutlwelobotlhoko yo o neng a tshaba isagwe.
Ke ne ka namolwa ke metsi mme ka godisiwa mo teng ga ntlo ya segosi ya ene mmusi yo o neng a batla go ntshenya.
Ke ne ka tswa mo nageng ya gaetsho morago ga tiragalo ya tshoganyetso, ka nna modisa yo o ikokobeditseng kwa nageng e e kgakala.
Ke ne ka boa go ya go lebana le mmusi yoo yo o maatla ka thobane e e sa raraanang le molaetsa o o utlwalang sentle, ke batla kgololesego ya batho ba gaetsho.
Ke ne ka kgaoganya ba ba neng ba ntshala morago metsi a magolo, mme ka lebelela fa metsi ao a ne a kometsa mmaba wa me yotlhe.
Ke ne ka palama thaba e e boitshepo go ya go amogela kaelo ya bomodimo go tswa go Allah, mme ke ne ka newa matshwao a le robongwe a a bonalang sentle e le bosupi jwa boammaaruri.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسْعَ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ ۖ فَسْـَٔلْ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِذْ جَآءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُۥ فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ مَسْحُورًۭا
verse: And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic." (17:101)
